Did callers reach us?

answered live, or called / texted back · by where the call came in
Answered live≤ 12h · same business day≤ 24h · next business day≤ 48h · 2nd business dayNeverStill inside the window
Leasing (queue, the 780-900-7420 line and leasing agents’ own lines) is timed in clock hours; everyone else in business days (9–5 Mon–Fri, Alberta stat holidays off). A caller who gets through on a later call counts as reached.

Phone leaderboard

ranked by callers reached on their own line · click a person for their unreturned callers
#PersonCallersTheir direct lineReachedQueue answeredCalled backTexted backCalls in / outTexts in / outAvg call
Callers = calls that rang their own line (queue calls and the shared leasing line are counted under Queue answered). Ranked only with 20+ callers in the window (20 per 30 days). Called / texted back = the first response to a caller nobody picked up. Avg call = talk time of calls they answered or placed that connected.

Needs a call back

every caller still waiting · last 90 days
CallerUnit · where they calledWaitingResponsible
A caller leaves this list on their own once anyone calls or texts them back, or picks up their next call. Responsible: tenants → their property manager; owners → the line they called (main line → Pearse); prospects → their tour agent, else the line they called, else Danai; known callers → whoever last talked to them; new callers → the line they called, or the queue’s shared pile.

Lease renewals

Lease ends pick one
State any of
State Event Property Unit Tenant(s) Lease ends New term Rent Balance Manager Updated
Current renewal cycle from Buildium — Not started = lease ends in the next 90 days and no renewal offer has been started; Lease ended = the term already ended with no renewal and no notice (still Active in Buildium — holding over); Offer sent = offer sent, waiting on the tenant’s answer; Declined = the tenant declined the offer; Not renewing (notice) = the tenant gave notice to vacate; Not renewing = the renewal was cancelled; offers and notices show even when the lease ends more than 90 days out. Event carries the same notice / eviction / listed / move-out flags as the Units board. Not sent = renewal drafted, not yet sent for signature; Pending = awaiting signatures; Signed = fully signed; Cancelled = renewal cancelled. Scope filters apply. Click a row to open the unit.

Leases

Status pick one
Balance on or off
Property · Unit Tenants Status Type From End Rent Balance Agent
Every current lease (plus the most recent lease on vacant units), mirrored daily from Buildium with balances, deposit state, attribution, and renewal status. Click a lease for tenant contacts, recurring transactions, and the live ledger — itemized charges & payments pulled straight from Buildium the moment you open it (never stored). Balance = the outstanding-balances mirror for active leases, or money received to date on future leases (“pre”). Sidebar scope filters apply.

Key manager

Status any of
Property · Unit Bin Status Holder Out Due back Last activity
Migrated from the Monday Key Ledger — this is now the system of record. Click a key to check it out / in, change status, or add a note; every action is logged in History. Sidebar owner and property filters apply to matched keys — the ledger always lists every key, even when your sign-in scopes the rest of the dashboard to your own portfolio. Every action is logged under your sign-in.

Tasks

Show any of
Property · Unit Task Type Status Priority Due Assignee
Live from Buildium — maintenance requests, resident requests, and to-dos. Defaults to open (new / in progress); use the chips for overdue, maintenance, unassigned, etc. Sidebar scope filters apply. Click a row for full detail, the update history, and any linked work order.
